{{Top|leg}}
'''Tingel's Ghost''' was the name of a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] cell that tracked the movements of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. The cell was founded by an agent called [[Tingel]].<ref name="LOTE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
